metadata.description: Composable traceability from decisions to tickets, commits, services and workflow steps

implementsTicket.description: Claims that a commit implements work described by a ticket; a bare ticket mention is insufficient and the link does not establish full ticket completion.

decidedIn.description: Links a commit to the recorded decision context or rationale for its change; it does not prove that the commit fulfilled the decision.

changesService.description: Identifies a service changed by a commit, supported by source or configuration changes; the link does not establish deployment or runtime effects.

fulfillsStep.description: Claims that a commit satisfies the recorded requirements of a workflow step; direct fulfillment evidence is needed and other steps or runtime outcomes are not implied.

motivatesRule.description: Identifies a business rule motivated by a decision; rationale alone does not establish implementation or enforcement of the rule.

realizedAsTask.description: Connects a follow-up action item to one or more execution tasks that realize or decompose its work; the records remain distinct and the link does not imply task completion.

tracksTask.description: Identifies an execution task tracked by a ticket; tracking is not identity, assignment or proof of task completion.

motivatesPolicy.description: Identifies a governing policy motivated by a decision; the rationale does not establish adoption, enforcement or compliance.
